status: Four new static proposals; only the baseline expression has author approval. No creature animation or production integration.

forms.name: Runová
forms.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one static evolution concept of the approved rune fox companion for a children's fantasy RPG.
Image 1 is the REQUIRED canonical identity and rendering reference. Keep this exact sophisticated fox identity: long pointed muzzle, naturally sized warm amber eyes, gentle relaxed white eyebrows and tiny friendly closed-mouth smile, pointed large upright ears, elegant slender fox anatomy, rich orange fur, layered white fur, intricate cyan runic filigree, one large bushy tail. Keep the original detailed hand-painted rendering: many clear layered fur strands, nuanced highlights and shadows, dark precise outlines. This is NOT a chibi, baby, plush toy, flat cartoon or new species. Do not round the muzzle, enlarge the eyes/head or simplify the existing detailed markings. Always friendly and cute.
The requested evolutionary stage changes the large fur/rune pattern and silhouette in the SPECIFIC way below. It is the SAME fox grown in magical mastery, not a costume swap. No armor, clothing, crown, weapon, horns, wings, extra tails, extra limbs or aggressive expression. Avoid turning every evolution blue or white; retain recognizable orange head, orange back and orange flank areas. No enormous aura clouds or distracting particles. Changes must read through real fur patterns even without glow.
One complete full-body creature on a small low mossy-stone island matching the reference. Genuine transparent background, clean antialiased edges without colored matte halos. Center the COMPLETE fox and ground inside a square canvas with generous clear padding on every side. Every ear, toe, hair tuft and tail tip must be fully visible. No text, letters, numerals, frames, UI, symbols floating outside the animal or multiple panels. This is a single static approval illustration, NOT an animation frame sheet.
Image 2 is a POSE reference only: use the naturally standing four-paw pose with a curious slight head tilt and tail sweeping behind to the right. Preserve the face and quality from image 1.
EVOLUTION 2 OF 5, a restrained first upgrade: keep most fur orange and the existing fine cyan filigree. Add neat white fur socks only at the FRONT paws, and one clearly recognizable broad curved cyan ribbon integrated into the tail fur, about one third down from the white tip. Thin elegant pale-gold edging follows that one tail rune; it is a painted magical marking, not jewelry wrapped around the tail. Shoulder runes become slightly clearer but retain the detailed pattern. White chest remains close to the original size. Curious, lively, approachable stance.

revision4.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET image 1 is evolution 4 of the rune fox. Preserve this EXACT evolution's appearance: richly detailed fur, orange head/back/flanks, broad layered white mane, white stockings, white forelock, friendly amber eyes, small gentle smile, cyan-and-gold connected runes and a full single tail with cyan crescent markings. Preserve its detailed mature elegant fox anatomy and sophisticated original fantasy game rendering.
CHANGE ONLY THE POSE and its natural perspective. The new pose must be unmistakably DIFFERENT from the existing left-facing raised paw: make the fox walk toward the RIGHT side of the image. Head and nose point RIGHT, tail streams horizontally toward the LEFT, body seen in a full side / slightly three-quarter view. Head gently turns a little toward the viewer, still a warm friendly face. The near front foreleg stretches forward toward the RIGHT just above the mossy ground as a long relaxed walking step; opposite front leg supports weight underneath. One hind leg trails to the LEFT and the other is stepping forward underneath. Full natural 4-legged walking anatomy, a fluid elongated body silhouette, no jumping. Not the bent paw held at chest height, not the existing static stance, not simply a horizontally flipped image.
Keep every cyan-and-gold motif recognizably belonging to this same fourth evolution, including the linked crescent tail motif. No new costume, armor, jewelry, new tail, creature, symbols, body enlargement, oversized head or baby style. A small low mossy stone island, full body including all four paws and entire left-streaming tail visible with 10% clear padding all around. Genuine transparent background with clean edges. One static concept, no words or UI and no animation frames.

outputs.name: Základní
outputs.alt: Původní oranžová liška s vlídným výrazem, jemnými tyrkysovými runami a zvednutou tlapkou.

outputs.name: Runová
outputs.alt: Liška stojí na čtyřech tlapkách, naklání hlavu a má bílé přední ponožky a jednu zlatem lemovanou runu na ocase.

outputs.name: Stříbrná
outputs.alt: Liška se hravě uklání, ocas drží vysoko; jeho stříbrná špička nese dvě zlatem lemované tyrkysové linky.

outputs.name: Zářivá
outputs.alt: Liška kráčí doprava, má bohatou bílou hřívu, bílé tlapky a propojené tyrkysové runy se zlatými okraji.

outputs.name: Hvězdná
outputs.alt: Liška sedí vzpřímeně, širokou stříbrnou hřívu a ocas zdobí tyrkysové hvězdné runy se zlatým lemem.
